info.title: Net Worth Backend API
info.description: RESTful API for managing personal net worth tracking including users, accounts, holdings, transactions, incomes, and watchlists.

tags.name: income-tags
tags.description: Income tag management for categorizing incomes

tags.name: income-sources
tags.description: Income source management for tracking income origins

tags.name: account-watchlists
tags.description: List watchlists containing a specific account

tags.name: chart-data
tags.description: Time-series chart data for holdings, accounts, and watchlists

value.message: Income for the same date, source and tag already exists.
Filter by accountId or holdingId is required

get.summary: List watchlists that include an account by account id

200.description: List of watchlists with current/previous day values and invested

post.description: Creates an income source. If `isDefault` is true, any existing default source for the same user will be unset so that only one source is default per user (application-level enforcement).

value.message: Income source with the same name already exists.

post.description: Creates an income tag. If `isDefault` is true, any existing default tag for the same user will be unset so that only one tag is default per user (application-level enforcement).

value.message: Income tag with the same name already exists.

post.summary: Create or ensure a user exists
post.description: Ensures a user exists for the given externalUserId using an idempotent insert (INSERT IGNORE). Returns 201 when a new user is created, or 200 when the user already exists. On first creation, a default watchlist named 'All' is created for the user.

get.summary: List income tags for a user by internal user id

patch.summary: Set an income tag as default by tag id

get.summary: List income sources for a user by internal user id

patch.summary: Set an income source as default by source id

get.summary: List incomes for a user by internal user id

value.message: Income for the same date, source and tag already exists.
Watchlist with the same name already exists.

get.summary: List watchlists for a user by internal user id

200.description: List of watchlists with current/previous day values and invested

patch.summary: Update a watchlist name by id

value.message: Watchlist with the same name already exists.
Account with the same name and type already exists.

get.summary: List accounts for a user by internal user id

200.description: List of accounts with current/previous day values and invested

value.message: Account with the same name and type already exists.

post.description: Creates a holding under an account. Only one unique symbol per account is allowed; if a holding with the same symbol already exists for the given account, the API returns HTTP 409 (Conflict).

409.description: Conflict: Holding with the same symbol already exists for this account

value.message: Holding with the same symbol already exists for this account

get.summary: List holdings for an account by account id

200.description: List of holdings with units from latest transaction value and current/previous day values and invested

get.summary: List accounts for a watchlist by id

200.description: List of accounts with current/previous day values and invested

post.summary: Link an account to a watchlist or a watchlist to an account

delete.summary: Unlink an account from a watchlist or a watchlist to an account

get.summary: Get chart data for holdings, accounts, or watchlists
get.description: Unified endpoint to fetch daily chart data for holdings, accounts, or watchlists with time period filtering and forward fill functionality.

200.description: Chart data points with forward fill

value.message: Transaction with the same date already exists.
accountId is required to create transaction
holdingId is required to create transaction
invested is required to create transaction
value is required to create transaction
mode is required and must be either 'add' or 'update'

get.summary: List transactions by accountId or holdingId

User.description: User entity representing an application user

externalUserId.description: External user identifier (e.g., from authentication provider)

CreateUserRequest.description: Request body for creating or ensuring a user exists

externalUserId.description: External user identifier (e.g., from authentication provider). Uses idempotent insert - returns existing user if already exists.

IncomeTag.description: Income tag for a user. Only one tag per user can have `isDefault=true`.

IncomeSource.description: Income source for a user. Only one source per user can have `isDefault=true`.

accountId.description: Account ID this transaction belongs to

holdingId.description: Holding ID this transaction is for

invested.description: Total invested amount after this transaction

CreateTransactionRequest.description: Request body for creating a transaction

mode.description: 'add' => adds to latest invested/value from previous transaction; 'update' => creates transaction with exact values provided

taxPaid.description: Tax paid on this income (defaults to 0 if not provided)

creditedDate.description: Date when income was credited (YYYY-MM-DD format)

UpdateIncomeRequest.description: Provide any subset of fields to update. At least one field is required.

name.description: Watchlist name (must be unique per user)

WatchlistSummary.description: Watchlist summary with aggregated value metrics from all linked accounts

currentDayValue.description: Current day total market value of all linked accounts

previousDayValue.description: Previous day total market value of all linked accounts

invested.description: Total invested amount across all linked accounts

Account.description: Account entity representing a financial account

needsDailyData.description: Whether account requires daily data fetching (e.g., from Dhan API)

Holding.description: Holding entity representing an investment position within an account

symbol.description: Holding symbol/ticker (must be unique per account)

CreateHoldingRequest.description: Request body for creating a new holding

symbol.description: Holding symbol/ticker (must be unique per account)

HoldingSummary.description: Holding summary with current value metrics

units.description: Number of units held (from latest transaction)

AccountSummary.description: Account summary with current value metrics

type.description: Account type (BROKER, SAVINGS, CREDIT_CARD, LOAN, OTHER)

needsDailyData.description: Whether account requires daily data fetching

currentDayValue.description: Current day total market value of all holdings

previousDayValue.description: Previous day total market value of all holdings

invested.description: Total invested amount across all holdings

ChartData.description: Single data point in a time-series chart representing daily value and investment

value.description: Market value on this date (uses forward fill for missing dates)

invested.description: Total invested amount as of this date (uses forward fill for missing dates)

CreateAccountRequest.description: Request body for creating a new account

name.description: Account name (must be unique per user and type)

isActive.description: Whether the account is active (defaults to true)

needsDailyData.description: Whether account requires daily data fetching from external APIs (defaults to false). Only settable at creation time.

UpdateAccountRequest.description: Request body for updating an account. Provide any subset of fields to update. At least one field is required.

name.description: New account name (must be unique per user and type)

CreateWatchlistRequest.description: Request body for creating a new watchlist

name.description: Watchlist name (must be unique per user)

UpdateWatchlistNameRequest.description: Request body for updating a watchlist name

name.description: New watchlist name (must be unique per user)

code.description: Error code (e.g., VALIDATION_ERROR, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, INTERNAL_ERROR)

WatchlistAccountLink.description: Represents a link between a watchlist and an account
